claims_checked.claim: H1 2026 operating cash flow was $3,013 million and company free cash flow was $352 million.
The H1 2026 interim dividend payment was $1,084 million and represented 80% of underlying NPAT.
H1 2026 gearing was 20.6%, outside the 10–20% target range.
FY2025 company-adjusted free cash flow was approximately $1.9 billion.
FY2025 Yahoo free cash flow was -$782 million.
FY2025 liquidity was approximately $9.3 billion and net debt approximately $8.0 billion.
FY2025 NPAT was $2,718 million, down 24% from 2024.
FY2025 company free cash flow was $1,889 million against a $2.1 billion dividend.
Yahoo FY2025 free cash flow was -$782 million and quarterly cash flow was suppressed.
H1 2026 free cash flow was $352 million against a $1,084 million interim dividend.
Liquidity at 30 September 2026 was approximately $7.8 billion and net debt approximately $8.9 billion.
The Capital Markets Day changed the distribution policy to 20–40% of adjusted operating cash flow.
FY2025 full-year dividend was 112 US cents, versus 122 US cents in 2024.
Scarborough first LNG remained targeted for Q4 2026 and Louisiana LNG first LNG for 2029.
